text: Truist Financial Corporation (NYSE: TFC) is a bank holding company with no state ownership; its 2026 proxy statement discloses BlackRock (7.9%), Capital International Investors (8.6%) and Vanguard Group (9.5%) as its only 5%-plus shareholders, each under 10%.

source.name: Truist DEF 14A 2026
source.quote: each of BlackRock, Inc., Capital International Investors, and Vanguard Group, Inc. reported that it or its affiliates beneficially owned or had investment discretion over more than 5% of the outstanding
